lines.text: MIL notes: Jakučionis has totaled 63 points in his last three games, marking his career-high in a three-game span, and he’s shooting 60.0% from the field and 47.6% from three in his last three outings compared to his 47.9% mark from the field and…

MIL notes: T-16th in NBA · Herro has tallied a team-high-tying four games this season with 15+ points on at least 50.0% shooting from both the field and from three, which are tied for the 16th-most in the league this season.

PHI is 13-3 with a point differential of +47 (+2.9 a game), which usually makes a 9-7 team: 3.6 wins more than its scoring margin says, the most above it in the NBA (4-0 in games decided by 5 or fewer)
Jaylen Brown OUT (left hamstring strain): PHI 2-0 without him (+5.0 a game), 11-3 with; A. Simons 9.5 → 19.5 pts, L. James 14.6 → 21.0 pts without him (2 games)
MIL has lost 12 straight: a loss tonight would be its first 13-game losing streak since 1995-96 (March 1996)
Brayden Burries is averaging 26.0 minutes over his last 11 games (since 10/31), up from 14.8 over the 5 games before (by chance: under 1 in 200)

Opposing forwards have scored 2.5 points a game more than their own averages against PHI (42 games of 15+ minutes), the most in the NBA; tonight: Jaime Jaquez Jr. (15.0 a game), Kyle Kuzma (12.3 a game)
Ryan Rollins is shooting 20.0% from three over his last 3 games (3-for-15, since 11/11), down from 69.2% over the 4 games before (9-for-13) (by chance: 1 in 67)
OG Anunoby DOUBTFUL (left calf tightness): NYK hasn't played without him this season (9-6 with him)
POR notes: 37th all-time · Holiday is the second current Trail Blazer to crack the NBA’s all-time scoring top 100—Damian Lillard currently ranks 37th on the list (22,912 points).

POR notes: Coming off the bench in every game so far this season, Jrue Holiday ranks highly in several bench categories: Total Bench Points 208 pts (1st); Points Per 36 Minutes 18.6 (6th); Assists Per 36 Minutes 5.7 (2nd); Assists 64 asts (2nd);…
Karl-Anthony Towns: double-double in 15 straight games, every game this season · questionable tonight
Series streak · 7: The Knicks have won 7 straight against the Trail Blazers, their longest ever against them (last: 127-97 on 1/30/26).

Josh Hart started but wasn't on the floor at the end of NYK's last 6 close games, most recently 11/19 vs MIN (out for the last 5:25); he sat the whole 4th in 2 of them; he had finished 4 of 4 before (close: within 5 in the last five minutes; at the end: on the floor for half of the last three)
Sidy Cissoko is averaging 29.8 minutes over his last 6 games (since 11/10), up from 21.1 over the 9 games before (by chance: under 1 in 200)
Donovan Clingan has the 3rd most blocks in the NBA this season. He ranks 117th in minutes played

LAC notes — Darius Garland: Streak · 13 (notes) · Dished out 5+ assists in 13 straight games (10/23 - 11/19), joins Harden & Paul as one of just three Clips to do this in last 10 yrs. → 14 if he does it again tonight.
LAC notes: 5th in NBA · The Clippers currently rank fifth in the NBA in points off the bench this season (44.1 ppg).

Derrick Jones Jr. is shooting 50.0% on threes this season (24-for-48), against 33.0% over his career before it (1,140 attempts): 17.0 points above his own rate, the furthest above among the 162 players with 40+ attempts
Kris Dunn is averaging 21.2 minutes over his last 6 games (since 11/8), down from 30.5 over the 8 games before (by chance: 1 in 101)
LAC is 0-6 on the road: one of 2 teams without a road win (MIL is the other)
P.J. Washington QUESTIONABLE (left shoulder impingement): DAL hasn't played without him this season (8-7 with him)
LAC is allowing 118.1 points a game (14 games): its most in franchise history
Rui Hachimura is averaging 1.1 turnovers over his last 7 games (since 11/4), down from 2.4 over the 5 games before (by chance: 1 in 50)
Cameron Boozer OUT (right ankle sprain): MEM hasn't played without him this season (12-4 with him)
MEM notes — Taylor Hendricks: Registered a season-high four steals and a career-high +27 plus-minus in his first start of the season on Nov. 19 vs. Golden State.
MEM notes — Cam Spencer: 2nd in NBA · Leads the NBA in true shooting percentage (.721) and ranks second in 3-point percentage (.559).

Rudy Gobert is shooting 44.6% on free throws this season (33-for-74), against 63.3% over his career before it (4,439 attempts): 18.7 points below his own rate, the furthest below among the 112 players with 30+ attempts
LaMelo Ball is averaging 0.7 free throw attempts over his last 6 games (since 11/8), down from 5.3 over the 4 games before (by chance: under 1 in 200)
Cam Spencer among bench players this season: 10th in points, 2nd in assists, 5th in plus/minus
MEM is 12-4: its best start through 16 games since 2014-15 (14-2)
Javon Small OUT (personal reasons): MEM 5-2 without him (+7.9 a game), 7-2 with; T. Jerome 21.8 → 27.4 pts, Q. Post 2.6 → 6.7 pts without him (7 games)
NOP notes: Only one this season · Queen is the only bench player in the NBA this season to average 11-plus points and six or more rebounds per game.

NOP notes: 1st in team history · The Pelicans are averaging 30.9 free throw attempts per game, which is the most free throw attempts per game in franchise history and ranks 1st in the NBA this season.
Dylan Harper OUT (left hip external rotator strain): SAS 1-0 without him (+12.0 a game), 12-3 with
Jeremiah Fears is averaging 32.2 minutes over his last 13 games (since 10/29), up from 23.0 over the 4 games before (by chance: under 1 in 200)
SAS has the NBA's best record since 2004-05 (1101-682)
SAS lead the NBA in blocks (6.6 a game), 0.9 more than the next team (LAL): a wider gap than the one across the next nine teams (0.3)

Devin Vassell is shooting 90.9% on free throws this season (30-for-33), against 80.7% over his career before it (701 attempts): 10.2 points above his own rate, the 4th-furthest above among the 112 players with 30+ attempts
Dejounte Murray is averaging 3.2 assists over his last 5 games (since 11/4), down from 6.0 over the 4 games before (by chance: 1 in 101)
SAC notes — Darius Acuff Jr.: NBA history · Recorded his second game with 20+ points and 10+ assists vs. LAL (11/4), becoming the sixth teenager in NBA history to have multiple 20-10 games.

SAC notes — Darius Acuff Jr.: 2nd all-time · With 29 points and six assists versus Orlando on Nov. 10th, he recorded his seventh consecutive game with 20+ points and 5+ assists, the second longest streak this season and the fourth longest streak for a rookie in NBA history.
Darius Acuff Jr. has 5 games of 30+ points this season (34.6 a game in them), and SAC is 0-5 in those games (1-9 in the others)

BOS hasn't allowed a 30-point game this season (15 games): the only team; 159 across the league. SAC's 30-point scorers: Darius Acuff Jr. (5, high 38), Zach LaVine (2, high 37), De'Andre Hunter (1, high 30)
Jayson Tatum QUESTIONABLE (rest): BOS 1-0 without him (+7.0 a game), 10-4 with
SAC is 0-9 at home: the only team without a home win
SAC is 1-14: its worst start through 15 games in franchise history (since 1948-49)
Darius Acuff Jr. among rookies this season: 1st in points, 1st in assists, 6th in steals, 1st in threes
